column1: # `conversation.md` Section 7's `0x88` row: "On a match against a live party
# member, **set the active scene's branch-flag bit for the NPC currently
# speaking** and print the affirmative acknowledgement; on empty input or no
# match, print the dismissive one." Neither literal is published.
# `dwelling-talk-after-entry` types `NAME`, which matches nobody, and measured
# the dismissive line as `"If you say so...`. This scenario is the same route
# and the same rat, answering with the party's own member instead. Section 7.6
# publishes the match rule as "the first four characters of a member's name,
# found at line start or immediately after a space"; the seed's roster panel
# decodes to a single member, `Avatar`, so `AVATAR` matches.
# **Measured 2026-09-12.** The original answers `"A pleasure!` - one row, an
# opening quote and no closing one, the same shape as the dismissive line. Red
# on its first run, because the engine printed nothing on this arm; green once
# the measured literal was read back into it.
# requires-seed: the party outside the hut, so the scenario can walk in through the door

Look east at the hut's NPC
Talk east after entering through the door
